headline.zh: 這是你從「寫程式」走向「打造系統」的一年：一個 AI Agent 框架、一個 Rust 儲存引擎，還有 486 次對 agent-forge 的專注。
headline.en: The year you went from writing code to building systems: an AI agent framework, a Rust storage engine, and 486 commits of focus on agent-forge.

tagline.zh: 從週末實驗長成 412 顆星的多 Agent 框架
tagline.en: From a weekend experiment to a 412-star multi-agent framework

highlights.zh: 設計工具沙盒，讓 agent 能安全執行指令
highlights.en: Designed a tool sandbox so agents can run commands safely

highlights.zh: 支援 SSE 串流輸出與規劃器拆分
highlights.en: Added SSE streaming and split out the planner

tagline.zh: 親手實作 LSM-tree，從 WAL 到 compaction
tagline.en: An LSM-tree built by hand, from WAL to compaction

highlights.zh: 以 fuzz test 抓出 WAL 重播的 off-by-one
highlights.en: Fuzz tests caught an off-by-one in WAL replay

tagline.zh: Go + Vue 的自架伺服器儀表板
tagline.en: A Go + Vue dashboard for home servers

tagline.zh: 年底的新挑戰：第一次用 Jetpack Compose
tagline.en: A year-end challenge: first app with Jetpack Compose

night_owl.zh: 凌晨的 commit 特別有靈感？記得也要睡覺。
night_owl.en: Inspiration strikes after midnight? Remember to sleep.

eternal_flame.zh: 整個暑假，一天都沒斷過。
eternal_flame.en: Not a single day missed all summer.

desc.zh: agent-forge 今年突破 400 顆星

detail.zh: 從 2 月建立到現在，agent-forge 成為你第一個被社群大量使用的專案。
detail.en: Created in February, agent-forge became your first project widely used by the community.

desc.zh: 親手寫出一個 LSM-tree 儲存引擎

detail.en: WAL, memtable, SSTables and compaction — all of it.

summary.zh: 2026 年，你推進了 6 個專案，其中 4 個是今年從零開始。你在 AI Agent 與底層儲存兩條完全不同的路線上同時前進，也開始把作品發佈出去，讓別人真正用上。
summary.en: In 2026 you pushed 6 projects forward, 4 of them started from scratch this year. You advanced on two very different tracks, AI agents and low-level storage, and began shipping work that other people actually use.

closing.zh: 謝謝這一年的自己。下一年，繼續把想法變成能跑的東西。
closing.en: Thank you, this year's you. Next year, keep turning ideas into things that run.
